title: 醒啦
brief: Nailü right wakes a dozing Xingtong left. X slumps and scrunches in a nightmare. N glances over, reaches to gently pat her shoulder, X startles upright, recognizes N, their shoulders ease and both breathe out. X settles back into the opening doze.

board.title: 醒啦
poses: 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong seated left, eyes closed and chin drooping, both hands on her thighs; Nailü sits right, looking forward with both hands on her thighs.
0.60 s: Deepen Xingtong's slump, pinch her brows and scrunch her shoulders; turn Nailü's eyes and head toward her.
1.15 s: Keep Xingtong tightly hunched; lift Nailü's left hand toward Xingtong's right shoulder, palm open, while her right hand stays on her thigh.
1.65 s: Place Nailü's left palm gently on Xingtong's right shoulder for a soft pat; keep Xingtong's eyes squeezed shut and hands planted.
2.05 s: Snap Xingtong upright with wide eyes and raised shoulders, looking ahead; let Nailü's palm follow the rising shoulder without gripping.
2.55 s: Turn Xingtong's gaze toward Nailü in recognition and soften her brows; lift Nailü's left palm just clear of the shoulder as she smiles back.
3.10 s: Lower both characters' shoulders and chests in a shared exhale; return Nailü's left hand to her thigh as Xingtong's eyelids soften.
3.75 s: Let Xingtong's eyes close and chin descend toward her opening doze; turn Nailü's gaze forward, keeping all four hands on their thighs.
4.50 s: Settle Xingtong into a relaxed doze with her chin slightly higher than in pose one; hold Nailü's opening posture for the final gentle downward drift.
board.continuity: Use one fixed full-body composition without props throughout the 4.8-second loop, preserving hand paths and gaze changes, with distinct pose nine easing into pose one.
